title: Spectral Admissibility of Real Observers in Euclidean de Sitter Gravity
summary: The Euclidean de Sitter path integral contains the familiar phase associated with conformal negative modes. Maldacena's construction shows that a suitably included real observer can reorganize the refined state-counting problem. This paper does not rederive that cancellation. It addresses the prior semiclassical admissibility question: which observer sectors couple to the de Sitter saddle as genuine metric observers without becoming spectators or producing infrared-singular backreaction?
